Your Questions, Answered

How do I book an appointment?

You can reserve a session directly through our online store. Choose your preferred artist, select a time slot, and pay the deposit securely to lock in your appointment.

What safety measures do you follow?

We use single-use needles, hospital-grade sterilization equipment, and EPA-approved disinfectants. Every workstation is sanitized before and after each client, and our artists wear fresh gloves for every procedure.

Can I see a design before committing?

Absolutely. During your consultation, we’ll discuss style, size, and placement. You’ll receive a digital mock-up for approval or revisions before any tattooing begins.

Let's Work Together

Ready to turn your vision into living art? Book a no-pressure virtual or in-studio consultation today to explore design ideas, pricing, and aftercare. Our artists will guide you through every step, so you can feel confident before the first drop of ink meets skin.
